title: Default planning style
question: Which default day-planning style would you rather TaskFlow shipped with?
context: This is the default every new user gets; it can be changed in settings later.

variants.label: Full auto-plan
variants.desc: TaskFlow plans your entire day end to end; you just follow it.

variants.label: Suggest-and-approve
variants.desc: TaskFlow proposes a plan and you tweak it before it's set.

title: When the day changes
question: When a meeting runs long, how should TaskFlow handle the rest of your day?
context: About how aggressive automatic re-planning should be.

variants.label: Re-plan automatically
variants.desc: It silently re-shuffles the rest of your day.

variants.label: Ask before re-planning
variants.desc: It pings you and waits for a tap before changing anything.

title: What to build next
question: Rank these from the one you MOST want to the one you LEAST want.
context: All are on the roadmap but not built yet.

variants.label: Mobile app
variants.desc: A full iOS/Android app, not just web.

variants.label: Shared team plans
variants.desc: Plan across a small team, not just yourself.

variants.label: Habit scheduling
variants.desc: Auto-schedule recurring habits like exercise or reading.

variants.label: Deeper time analytics
variants.desc: Where your time actually goes, by project.

title: Your call
question: If TaskFlow could build or fix ONE thing next, what would it be — and what would you still want to ask before committing?
context: Open floor — not limited to anything above.
